correctness.rationale: All 36 allowed length-four factors define 24 nonisolated triples. Eighteen forced degree-one vertices collapse to a symmetric six-vertex triangular prism, whose 75 directed root-arborescences yield 4800 rooted-at-0120 Euler tours by BEST. For each symbol transposition the quotient Laplacian cofactor is 5 and total cover voltage is odd, yielding 40 fixed cycles; the 3-cycle quotient has zero cover voltage, yielding no such symmetries. Six uniquely occurring palindromic triples preclude pure reversal; four uniquely occurring transposition-reversal-invariant 4-factors preclude mixed reversal. Burnside yields 820 and 410. The embedded exhaustive 36-edge verifier independently checks 4800 full cycles and every action.

value.rationale: This is the smallest nonbinary onto-word setting with word length strictly exceeding alphabet size and a nontrivial strongly connected overlap graph. The exact finite family has a natural combinatorial definition and gives full labeled, relabeled and reversal-quotiented invariants. The forced-path triangular-prism structure, nontrivial transposition-fixed classes and vanishing other symmetries explain the counts mathematically and provide exact benchmarks for universal-cycle generation. Scope is finite and no unsupported general extrapolation is made.
